guardia.explica: People in the coordination can guard the secret ballot. The voting key stays only on this device; the server gets only the public part, signed by your account's identity.
guardia.semIdentidade: To have a voting key, turn on the new chat on this device: it keeps your account's identity, which signs the key.
guardia.semDiretorio: Turn on the new chat on this device first: the voting key goes along with your account's identity.
guardia.nenhuma: You don't have a voting key yet.
guardia.ok: Your voting key is on this device and published.
guardia.outroAparelho: Your published voting key is not on this device. Use the device where it was created, or create another: votes already created still need the old one.
guardia.riscos: Risks, plainly: the key is stored in this browser. If you clear the site's data, use “Quick exit” or the panic password, it is gone, and you can't help open the votes where you are already a guardian (the others can, if there are enough). Anyone holding this device unlocked can use it.

urna.semChave: This vote doesn't have the guardians' key yet. Nobody votes until whoever opened it picks the guardians.
urna.semChaveCriar: Before the first vote, pick the guardians: people from the coordination who, together, open the ballots when the vote ends. Without this, nobody votes.
urna.abrem: {k} of {n} guardians together open the ballots, only after the deadline. Neither Alumia nor the server can open them.
urna.impressaoAjuda: If the fingerprint is the same for you and the guardians, the key is the same. Compare outside the app if you can.
urna.naoConfere: This vote's key doesn't check out: the signature is wrong. Don't vote and tell the coordination.
urna.trocada: The identity of who opened this vote or of a guardian has changed. Don't vote before checking with the coordination.
urna.naoConferida: The identities haven't been checked against this device's public log yet. Compare the fingerprint with a guardian.
urna.souGuardia: You are one of this vote's guardians.
urna.parteOk: Your share opens with this device's key.
urna.parteNao: Your share does NOT open with this device's key. Tell the coordination before the first vote.
urna.parteSemChave: Your voting key is not on this device.
urna.esperando: The vote has ended. The guardians are opening the ballot box: {e} of {k} shares delivered.
urna.abridora: You open the ballot box: with {k} shares, the ballots open on this device and only the choices, shuffled, go back to the server.

escolha.explica: Pick 3 to 7 people from the coordination and how many of them must come together to open. Fewer: it still opens if someone loses their key; more: a small group can't open it alone.
escolha.poucas: Only {n} person(s) in the coordination have a voting key. At least 3 are needed. Ask them to create the key on the vote screen.
escolha.publicando: Creating the key on this device…

erros.sem_identidade: Turn on the new chat on this device: with your account's identity it checks the vote's creator and guardians against the public log, and signs your key. Without it, nothing is sent.
erros.sem_chave: This vote doesn't have the guardians' key yet.
erros.chave_nao_confere: This vote's key doesn't check out. Nothing was sent.
erros.identidade_trocada: An identity changed in the public log. Nothing was sent.
erros.guardia_sem_assinatura: One guardian's key doesn't match her identity.
erros.sem_chave_aqui: Your voting key is not on this device.
erros.parte_nao_abre: Your share doesn't open with this device's key.
erros.urna_inchada: There are more ballots than people who voted. The box was not opened: tell the coordination.
erros.partes_nao_conferem: The delivered shares don't rebuild this vote's key. Nothing was opened: tell the coordination.
erros.ja_tem_chave: This vote already has a key.
erros.ja_tem_votos: This vote already has votes: the key can no longer change.
erros.invalido: The chosen guardians don't work. Pick 3 to 7 people from the coordination who have a voting key.
